description: This Java source file defines an Android activity 'CreateBitmap' that demonstrates bitmap creation, encoding, decoding, and rendering on a Canvas. It includes methods to generate color data, create bitmaps with different configurations, encode/decode using JPEG and PNG formats, and display these bitmaps in a custom View.
